files.lc_config.yaml:
general:
  basedir: <ROOT>/basedir
  bidsdir_name: BIDS
  deriv_layout: new
  containerdir: <ROOT>/containers
  container: rtp2-preproc
  analysis_name: rtp2-preproc_new
  host: local
  use_dask: false
  force: false
container_specific:
  anatrois:
    version: 4.6.1-7.3.2
    pre_fs: true
    prefs_dir_name: anatrois_4.6.1-7.3.2
    prefs_analysis_name: prefs
    prefs_zipname: ^anatrois_S.*\.zip$
    annotfile: null
    mniroizip: null
    use_src_session: '01'
  freesurferator:
    version: 0.2.1_7.4.1
    pre_fs: false
    prefs_dir_name: anatrois_4.6.1-7.3.2
    prefs_analysis_name: prefs
    prefs_zipname: ^anatrois.*\.zip$
    control_points: false
    prefs_unzipname: S.*$
    annotfile: <ROOT>/configs/fake_annots.zip
    mniroizip: null
    use_src_session: '01'
  rtppreproc:
    version: 1.2.0-3.0.3
    precontainer_anat: freesurferator_0.2.1_7.4.1
    anat_analysis_name: fakeanat
    separated_shell_files: false
    rpe: false
  rtp2-preproc:
    version: 0.2.1_3.0.4
    precontainer_anat: freesurferator_0.2.1_7.4.1
    anat_analysis_name: fakeanat
    separated_shell_files: false
    rpe: true
    use_qmap: false
    qmap_dir_name: x
    qmap_analysis_name: x
    qmap_fname: ^qmap.*\.zip$
  rtp2-pipeline:
    version: 0.2.1_3.0.4
    precontainer_anat: freesurferator_0.2.1_7.4.1
    anat_analysis_name: fakeanat
    precontainer_preproc: rtp2-preproc_0.2.1_3.0.4
    preproc_analysis_name: fakepre
    tractparams: <ROOT>/configs/tractparams.csv
    fsmask: null
    use_qmap: false
    qmap_dir_name: x
    qmap_analysis_name: x
    qmap_fname: ^qmap.*\.zip$
host_options:
  local:
    use_module: false
    apptainer: apptainer/latest
    mount_options:
    - <ROOT>
    manager: local
    launch_mode: serial
    njobs: 2
    memory_limit: 4GiB
    threads_per_worker: 1
  BCBL:
    use_module: true
    apptainer: apptainer/latest
    mount_options:
    - /bcbl
    - /tmp
    manager: sge
    job_name: lc
    cores: 6
    memory: 32G
    queue: long.q
    walltime: '24:00:00'
  DIPC:
    use_module: true
    apptainer: Apptainer/1.2.4
    mount_options:
    - /scratch
    manager: slurm
    job_name: lc
    cores: 6
    memory: 32G
    partition: general
    qos: regular
    walltime: '24:00:00'
